Over the 12 months to 31 October 2026 the company repurchased 7.6 million shares for $16.7 million. Recent liquidity events include City Therapeutics (0.6% of NAV) which closed +70% on IPO day (129% vs cost) and Lycia (2.9% of NAV) which closed +67% (233% vs cost). Corxel represents 4.8% of NAV (~$43.9m) and its planned SPAC deal is expected to raise c.$377m with completion in H1 2027.
